title: CDK-X Provider
description: Scaffold a new @cdk-x/<name> provider library: a jsii-enabled library (via @cdk-x/nx:library) plus a plain schemas/ directory and a pre-wired, initially-empty generate-l1 target.

name.description: Short kebab-case provider name (e.g. "github"). Used for the packages/<name> directory and the @cdk-x/<name> npm package.
name.x-prompt: What is the short (kebab-case) name of the provider?

providerName.description: Human-readable provider name (e.g. "GitHub"), used in the default library description.
providerName.x-prompt: What is the human-readable name of the provider (e.g. "GitHub")?

apiVersion.description: The cdkx-owned API group and version every Resource in this library shares, e.g. "github.cdk-x.com/v1". Pre-filled into the generate-l1 target's options.
apiVersion.x-prompt: What apiVersion should this provider's Resources share (e.g. "github.cdk-x.com/v1")?

languages.description: Additional jsii target languages to generate bindings for, beyond npm (always implicit).

x-prompt.message: Which additional jsii target languages should this provider ship?

phase.description: Release phase recorded as a project.json tag.

x-prompt.message: What release phase should this provider start in?
